verdict: Adobe Marketo Engage: Choose Adobe Marketo Engage when enterprise B2B marketing automation and Adobe/CRM-integrated ops are the primary job. Scores use the marketing-editorial methodology from first-party research as of 2026-08-17 — not hands-on product testing.
strengths: Enterprise B2B MAP depth and credibility
Strong automation, attribution, and CRM integrations
AI assistance marketed across journey tooling
weaknesses: Value depends on utilization at enterprise scale
bestFor: Enterprise B2B teams needing MAP-grade nurture and lead management
Adobe Experience Cloud / complex CRM-integrated marketing ops
Buyers comparing HubSpot Enterprise and Salesforce Account Engagement
notIdealFor: SMBs wanting published freemium ESP pricing
Creators whose primary job is social scheduling or simple funnels
tradeoffs: Specialist depth (listening vs scheduling vs funnels) vs all-in-one breadth
Published entry price vs contact/profile/mention upgrade pressure
Marketing automation / email depth vs pure ESP peers
recommendation: Choose Adobe Marketo Engage when enterprise B2B marketing automation and Adobe/CRM-integrated ops are the primary job. Compare Salesforce Account Engagement (Pardot) for Salesforce-native B2B MA, HubSpot for broader SMB-to-enterprise marketing+CRM, Braze for B2C engagement, and ActiveCampaign for mid-market automation.
